description: Build an editable RayTK ROP expression graph from a preset or explicit nodes/edges: copy RayTK masters live via pathsByOpType/category search, wire typed connectors, apply simple parameter values, lay out copied nodes deterministically, and expose the selected output through out1. Complements create_raytk_scene (minimal scene) and create_raytk_op (single ROP). Requires RayTK staged and loaded; offline tests validate payload/registration only, while live render/cook proof remains explicit.

add_camera.description: Append lookAtCamera and wire it into renderer input 1 when a renderer exists.

add_light.description: Append pointLight and wire it into renderer input 2 when a renderer exists.

add_material.description: Append basicMat between the SDF/combine tail and renderer when absent.

add_renderer.description: Append raymarchRender3D when the graph has no output ROP.

capture_preview_image.description: Capture an inline preview from out1. RayTK shader compile may still be asynchronous.

edges.description: Custom graph edges. Preset edges are used when nodes are omitted.

library_path.description: Optional explicit path to the loaded RayTK library COMP. Omit to probe pathsByOpType and known namespaces live.

name.description: Name for the generated graph container.

nodes.description: Custom RayTK ROP graph nodes. Leave empty to use the selected preset.

category.description: Optional RayTK category hint, e.g. sdf, combine, material, camera, light, output.

id.description: Stable graph node id. Used for edges and as the copied ROP name.

label.description: Optional human label carried into the report.

node_x.description: Optional nodeCenterX override. Omit to auto-layout the graph deterministically.

node_y.description: Optional nodeCenterY override. Omit to auto-layout the graph deterministically.

op_type.description: RayTK ROP master name, e.g. sphereSdf, boxSdf, simpleUnion, basicMat, raymarchRender3D.

parameters.description: Optional direct RayTK parameter values to try on the copied ROP. Unknown RayTK parameter names become warnings, not hard failures.

output_node_id.description: Node id to expose through out1. Defaults to the renderer added or inferred by the tool.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path to build inside.

preset.description: Starter graph to build when nodes are omitted. Use custom with explicit nodes/edges.

name: raytk_expr_graph_builder
title: Build RayTK expression graph
